captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a mountain bike suspension fork assembly integrated with a handlebar and stem. The upper assembly features a silver steer tube, a dual-clamp alloy crown, and black riser handlebars fitted with matching black grips. Below the crown, two golden-anodized stanchion tubes slide telescopically into black lower fork legs via prismatic joints, simulating suspension travel.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a mountain bike suspension fork with flat riser handlebars. The assembly should feature a silver steer tube, a dual-plate alloy crown, golden stanchions, and black lower legs that slide along the stanchions via prismatic joints. Include a direct-mount stem clamping a black handlebar with textured grips.
captions.factory: The code constructs an articulated assembly starting with a main crown part using Box and Cylinder primitives. It attaches a silver steer tube and a black direct-mount stem holding a transverse cylindrical handlebar with end grips. Below the crown, two golden stanchion cylinders are defined. Prismatic joints are then modeled to connect these stanchions to the black lower fork legs, allowing vertical sliding motion.
